items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: Me and Tony used to go... You know when he wrote the song there? Yeah, pretty big. Me and Tony.

ctx.x: Me and Tony used to go... You know when he wrote the song there? Yeah, pretty big. Me and Tony. And what's the other fellow's name? Let me get it right now. Not only Tony. What you call him? But he wrote all those songs. Tony died.
